title: Peruvian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful beef stew with a Peruvian twist, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth, chile, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
